name: Caetano v. Massachusetts
summary: The Supreme Court vacated a Massachusetts decision upholding a ban on stun guns, reaffirming that the Second Amendment extends to weapons not in existence at the time of the Founding and that are in common use today.
significance: Petitioners cite Caetano for the principle that the Second Amendment protects modern weapons not in existence at the Founding, and that courts cannot limit protection only to weapons available in 1791.
